audit_fields.notes: Solver export from GTO Wizard solution Cash6mGeneral_6mNL25R25, six-max cash, 100bb effective, NL25 rake, cold calls allowed. Raise sizings collapse into the single raise action because a spot key carries no size; the sizes are committed separately in sizings/six_max_nl25_100bb.json.
